answer: Behavioral Correlation Audit. Each identity’s transaction timing and counterparty mix are scored against a sybil profile; accounts in the same saffron cluster are flagged when their activity sequences correlate above a threshold. The system builds a trellis of repeated interaction motifs across accounts. A rising delta between cluster size and distinct external counterparties triggers review. An attacker must sustain genuinely uncorrelated behavior across each identity, costing separate operational histories and independent counterparty graphs per account.
